Gas Portfolio Tracker  ·  v2.3.0

Know if you’ll actually
hit the deadline.

A desktop tracker for a gas SVQ / NVQ portfolio — assisted hours, unassisted write‑ups, boiler and fault coverage, and the one date that says whether you’re on track.

The gauge

Your total hours against your goal, read like a pressure gauge. The red line is the 275‑hour pass mark; the needle sweeps to where you are the moment you open it.

  • Needle sweeps on load
  • Redline at the pass mark
  • Live as you log

The one number that matters

“Earliest realistic finish” is the later of two dates — every hour done, and all fourteen write‑ups done at your pace. It tells you which one is holding you back.

  • Hours gate vs write‑ups gate
  • Coverage still missing
  • Days of slack to the deadline

Log it in seconds

A big value, quick‑add steppers, one button. Log today or back‑date it. Set a whole week in one go. And turn any logged day straight into an unassisted write‑up — the hours move across, they never double‑count.

  • +0.5 / +1 / +2 / +4
  • → write‑up in one click
  • Whole‑week total

Write-ups & coverage

Five installs, five services, four repairs — and every boiler type and every repair fault covered. The bars fill, the pills turn green, and the app won’t let a gap hide.

  • Boiler + fault coverage
  • Per‑type progress bars
  • Linked to the supervising engineer

Assessor-ready PDF

One page, your name on it, the app’s own graphics — hours, pace, counts, coverage, the engineers you’ve worked under, and the full log. Export and hand it over.

  • No photos, just the numbers
  • Your Gas Safe engineers listed
  • One click

Always on your desktop

A menu‑bar icon and a translucent desktop widget that sits behind your windows and keeps going after you close the app. Total, pace and the pass mark at a glance.

  • Menu‑bar quick‑log
  • Frosted desktop card
  • Starts at login

Yours. Private. Current.

Everything is stored on your machine — nothing is uploaded. The app checks for updates on launch and swaps itself in on restart, so your logged hours and settings are never touched. macOS and Windows, built from the same code, identical.

  • Local‑only data
  • In‑app updates
  • macOS + Windows
